backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining user profiles, pets, categories, breeds, and admin video storage with authorization mixins and helper functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of major frontend content, pages, components, and AI modules.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base layers and custom theme variables for light/dark modes including admin dashboard colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures global routing for public, authenticated, and admin pages using TanStack Router and layout components.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminShell: Admin layout wrapper providing consistent page structure, breadcrumbs, and themed styling.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminVideo: UI for selecting a breed, pet type, or health topic and listing/editing/deleting associated video links. Fetches videos by category and displays loading, empty, and populated states.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlobImageU: Image uploader component that validates, previews, and uploads images as ExternalBlob objects with progress tracking. Supports clearing the current image and showing upload status.
frontend/src/components/ai/behavior/Beha: Collects basic pet behavior details and runs an AI-based behavior health assessment. Displays concern level, explanation, and next steps with reset capability.
frontend/src/components/ai/breed/BreedId: Developer test harness that runs automated breed-identification test cases and reports pass/fail results. Shows pass rate and detailed test outputs.

Image-based breed identification tool allowing users to upload a pet photo and optional hint, then displays predicted breed, confidence, and explanation. Includes result view, preview, and reset functionality.
frontend/src/components/ai/emergency/Eme: Multi-step flow for collecting symptom details and generating an emergency triage assessment. Shows urgency level, recommendations, and allows restarting the assessment.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Wraps content with auth and admin checks, showing loaders or an access-denied message when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Redirects unauthenticated users to login and shows a loading state until identity is available.
frontend/src/components/common/CatalogIm: Renders an image with lazy loading and swaps to a fallback source if the main image fails.
frontend/src/components/common/SectionCa: Provides a reusable card layout with optional title and description around arbitrary content.
frontend/src/components/favorites/Favori: Toggles a video as a favorite, handling auth checks, backend mutations, and UI state.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main page structure including navbar, footer, and a content area.
frontend/src/components/media/CatalogIma: Displays an image with an optional fallback placeholder when loading fails.
frontend/src/components/media/YouTubeEmb: Embeds a YouTube video from a URL and optionally shows a favorite button for it.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Renders breadcrumb navigation with optional links for each item.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Foote: Displays the site footer with attribution and a disclaimer message.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Shows the main navigation bar with links, authentication controls, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Dashb: Form workflow for creating a pet profile and optional vaccination entry during onboarding.
frontend/src/components/profile/Favorite: Manages a user's saved favorites, allowing removal and handling missing profiles.
frontend/src/components/profile/PetsMana: Manages adding, editing, and deleting pets in a user profile with form state, dialogs, and image upload support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileE: Allows users to edit and save personal profile details including name, email, and profile photo.
frontend/src/components/profile/Vaccinat: Handles adding and updating vaccination records for pets, including due dates and completion status.
frontend/src/content/health/healthCatalo: Defines structured health categories with detailed topics covering grooming, nutrition, vaccination, and emergency care.
Provides catalog data describing various pet breeds with traits, care tips, health issues, videos, and images.
frontend/src/content/pets/petsCatalog.ts: Defines pet catalog interfaces and a static dataset of pet categories, subcategories, and detailed small-mammal entries.
frontend/src/content/recommendations.ts: Provides rotating daily care tips and a static list of recommended pet‑care videos.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminVideos.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing admin‑managed video links via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerRole.ts: Hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin privileges.
React Query hooks for CRUD operations on pet categories and breeds through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state management via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profiles, dashboard info, pets, vaccinations, favorites, and videos using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVaccinationDueToda: Computes and updates a countdown to end‑of‑day for authenticated users’ vaccination reminders.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme variables for light/dark and admin modes, and shared UI utility classes.
Implements a scoring system to assess pet behavior health and returns a concern level with explanations and next steps.
Provides breed identification by tokenizing filenames and hints, scoring matches, and returning the best breed result with confidence.
frontend/src/lib/ai/breedIdentificationT: Contains structured test cases for validating the breed identification logic using various filename and hint combinations.
frontend/src/lib/ai/emergencyTriageRules: Evaluates symptom severity and frequency to classify emergency urgency levels with recommended actions.
frontend/src/lib/vaccinationReminders.ts: Generates vaccination reminder messages based on due dates and includes utilities for countdown timing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBreedsPage: Admin interface to list, create, edit, and delete breeds with form dialogs, image uploads, and category assignment.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories: Admin page for managing pet categories, including adding, editing, deleting, and uploading images or videos.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLandingPag: Admin dashboard linking to management sections for categories, breeds, and video links.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminVideosPage: Admin panel for adding, editing, and removing categorized video links tied to breeds, pet types, or health topics.
frontend/src/pages/ai/AIAssistantPage.ts: AI assistant hub offering emergency triage, behavior assessment, breed identification, and optional developer test tools.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPa: Explains Internet Identity–based account recovery and links users to the recovery page with navigation back to login.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login flow and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard with signup and recovery links.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignupPage.tsx: Provides an Internet Identity–based signup flow with feature highlights and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the user dashboard with authentication checks, data loading states, pet onboarding, and various widgets like reminders and tips.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCareLand: Displays main health categories with icons and links to their respective detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCategory: Shows a selected health category’s description and lists its topics with navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthTopicPag: Displays detailed health topic info including symptoms, causes, prevention, care steps, emergency alerts, and related videos.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing hero content, feature highlights, and navigation to AI tools or user dashboard depending on authentication.
Shows detailed breed information from backend or static data, including images, description, optional traits, and videos.
frontend/src/pages/pets/BreedListPage.ts: Lists breeds for a given pet category using backend or static data with images and links to detail pages.
Displays a pet category using backend or static data, showing description, optional breeds link, and subcategories with pet previews.
frontend/src/pages/pets/PetDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed info for a specific pet including description, care list, videos, and breadcrumbs.
Renders a grid of pet categories from backend or static data with icons, images, and navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page with tabbed management for account info, pets, vaccinations, and favorites.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and layout settings for the project.
project_state.json: Describes project state, existing features, and pending admin dashboard and authorization requirements.
